card.name: Slash in radiation dose units
card.fires_on: The slash or divider inside radiation dose-per-activity units such as mGy/MBq, and nearby pieces of units like millicuries. It appears in radiopharmaceutical dosimetry tables.

modes.label: Slash in dose units
modes.description: The slash between a dose unit and an activity unit in dosimetry table headers.

modes.label: Partway through millicurie
modes.description: The middle of the word millicuries in administered activity ranges.

card.plain: It marks the divider in units like mGy per MBq in radiation dose tables for imaging agents.
